meta.title: AudioBook Manager Status
shell.secret: You found the secret level. It has no loot. Only uptime.
foot.wit.0: No bards were harmed in the making of this page.
foot.wit.1: Roll for initiative. Then roll for a restart.
foot.wit.2: This status page is 90% uptime and 10% dramatic lighting.
foot.wit.3: The mimic in the corner is also a status page. Do not open it.
foot.wit.4: Please keep all hands, tentacles and webhooks inside the party.
foot.wit.5: It is not a bug. It is a lich with unfinished business.
ball.ok.0: The crystal ball is clear. The wizards are napping.
ball.ok.1: Nothing is on fire. Checked twice, once with a lantern.
ball.ok.2: All quiet. Suspiciously quiet. Enjoy it.
ball.ok.3: The oracle reports: no dragons, no 503s.
ball.degraded.0: The crystal ball has clouded over. A cleric is being fetched.
ball.degraded.1: Something is wrong, but the party is on it. Mostly with snacks.
ball.degraded.2: A wild error appeared. The party rolled for initiative.
ball.down.0: The ball has gone dark. This is fine. (It is not fine.)
ball.down.1: Total party knockout. A bard is already composing the sad song.
ball.poked: The ball says: have you tried turning it off and on again? Mage, please stop shaking the ball.
home.empty.title: No data yet
home.empty.line: The party is still assembling. The first scry lands within a few minutes of the first worker run.
home.onFeet.one: {up} of {count} party member on their feet
home.onFeet.other: {up} of {count} party members on their feet
home.rest.title: The party is taking a long rest
home.rest.dawn: Back on their feet when the dawn comes.
quest.outStill: {name} was knocked out and still is
flavour.down: {name} is knocked out. A cleric has been summoned. The chart says: {error}.
flavour.downFor: {name} is knocked out for {duration}. A cleric has been summoned. The chart says: {error}.
flavour.rest: {name} is resting at the inn. Please do not poke the sleeping party member.
flavour.degraded: {name} ate something questionable {ago} and is still a little green. Drinking a potion.
flavour.fresh: {name} just rolled initiative. The streak starts now.
flavour.streak.0: {name} has rolled a natural 20 on staying up for {streak}.
flavour.streak.1: {name}: {streak} without a scratch. The bards are running out of rhymes.
flavour.streak.2: {name} has been on its feet for {streak}. Nobody knows how, and nobody asks.
day.unformed: {date}: the party had not formed yet.
strip.label: {label}, {summary} Use the arrow keys to read each day.
chart.label: Response time for {name} over the last 12 hours
chron.title: The Quest Log
chron.lede: A chronicle of battles fought, naps taken, and the occasional goblin.
chron.empty: No quests on record. The bards are bored.
chron.outStill: {name} was knocked out and has not got up yet
